section_summary.extract_value: This procedure section describes the validation and administration of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) among Brazilian young adolescents in a classroom setting. The BAS was adapted through collaboration with original authors and professionals, with informed consent obtained from parents. Data collection involved classroom administration of the BAS by trained researchers, followed by individual anthropometric measurements (weight/height) conducted by the main researcher in a private setting to ensure participant privacy.
